question: Al-Biruni wrote his book 'Kitab-ul-Hind' in which language?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arabic**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Al-Biruni** wrote his famous book **'Kitab-ul-Hind'** in the **Arabic language**.
 
• Al-Biruni was a** Persian scholar and polymath** who made significant contributions to various fields such as **astronomy, mathematics, and history**.
 
• 'Kitab-ul-Hind' is an in-depth study of Indian culture, philosophy, science, and religion during the early 11th century.
 
• The book provides a comprehensive account of Indian knowledge and practices, showcasing Al-Biruni's dedication to understanding and documenting different cultures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In addition to 'Kitab-ul-Hind', Al-Biruni wrote numerous other works on subjects ranging from astronomy to pharmacology.
 
• He traveled extensively and learned several languages, which helped him in his scholarly pursuits and in understanding various cultures.
 
• Al-Biruni's works are considered valuable resources for understanding the scientific and cultural history of the medieval Islamic world and beyond.
